instagram:
Website par call button nahi dikhta? Customer ne services padhin, prices dekhe, sab pasand aaya. Phir call karna chaha, par number kahin nahi dikha. Do baar scroll kiya, footer tak gaya, aur tab band kar diya.

Yeh website ki sabse aam galti hai, aur theek karne mein sabse aasan: koi saaf next step nahi. Next step yaani woh ek button jo customer ko bataye ki ab kya karna hai, jaise 'Call karein', 'WhatsApp par poochhein' ya 'Quote maangein'. Visitor website padhta nahi, scan karta hai. Pehle kuch seconds mein action na dikhe to woh chala jata hai.

✅ Hero section mein sabse upar ek bada aur saaf button, jis par wahi likha ho jo hoga, jaise 'WhatsApp par price poochhein', sirf 'Submit' nahi
✅ Mobile par neeche ek sticky bar jisme Call aur WhatsApp dono hon
✅ Har service page ke aakhir mein wahi button dobara
✅ Ek page par ek hi main action, das alag buttons nahi

Test: apne phone par apni website kholiye aur timer lagaiye. Kitne seconds mein call ya WhatsApp kar paaye?

Aapki website par call button dhundhne mein kitne seconds lagte hain? Comment mein bataiye 👇
